Laura — thanks for the packet. Quick thoughts inline:

- Base: comp band shows 180k–230k for Senior ML Eng (SEA). Given her experience with latency optimization and the product fit, I'd target 205,000 base.
- Equity: target 0.30% (4-year vest, 1-yr cliff) — feel free to include standard accelerated vesting for change-in-control only.
- Sign-on: candidate will likely request a sign-on. Recommend $25k lump sum (taxed through payroll).

If Karthik is okay with comp economics and exec sign-off path, I'll approve and Laura can send. I also made some redline suggestions in the attached doc (highlighted).

Thanks for the breakdown Mark. A few accounting/comp items to note: 

- Comp band check: for Senior hires in SEA we should stay at or below the midpoint unless there's an exceptional match. 205k is above midpoint but still within band — approved from comp perspective with a note in the record.
- Equity: 0.30% is OK; recommend we state grant as RSU (standard) and include language for potential refresh at 1-year performance review.

- Relocation: prefer lump-sum taxable payment to simplify admin. $6k is standard.
- Severance: strongly recommend we do not include a severance clause in the offer letter. If candidate requests, HR/legal can offer a separate severance agreement after escalation.
- Hiring pad: mark budget code HR-REQ-7890 and note headcount already approved for Q2 plan. No additional headcount approvals needed.
